question_text:
7.
The capital structure of KPS Limited includes 5,00,000 equity shares of ` 10
each. The market price of equity share (cum-dividend) is ` 75 per share. The
company has declared to pay dividend on equity shares @ ` 6 per share

4
which will be paid within next three days. The company has a history of
consistent growth in its dividends. It has been predicted that in the next
year KPS Limited will pay dividend on its equity shares@ ` 7.59 per share.
The rate of dividend growth will be maintained in foreseeable future. The
cost of equity is calculated as:
(A)
36.5%
(B)
34.5%
(C)
37.5%
(D)
38.5%
